milestone: known-good fixture — every capability is genuinely reachable

capabilities.name: scratch working directory
capabilities.excludes: nested directories below the first level; anything outside the scratch dir
capabilities.remedy: create the scratch directory and make it writable before re-running

negative_control.why: listing a path that does not exist must fail; if it succeeds the read probe is not reading what it claims

capabilities.name: scratch git object store
capabilities.population: the object database of the scratch repo at $PREFLIGHT_TEST_DIR/repo
capabilities.excludes: remotes, refs, and every other repo on this machine
capabilities.remedy: initialise the scratch repo, or point the manifest at the repo the milestone actually writes to

negative_control.why: the scratch dir is not a repo; if this resolves, the read probe is answering from some other repo up the tree

capabilities.name: removable volume the milestone does not depend on
capabilities.remedy: connect the volume if a later milestone needs it; this one is planned around it

declared_unreachable.why: the volume is not mounted on this host
